definition: Named writing system or script used as the object of discussion.
inclusion_rule: The text explicitly names or shows the writing system.
exclusion_rule: Only a brand or individual font is named.
notes: Use object_label for the canonical label.

definition: Named style family such as seal or sans.
inclusion_rule: The text identifies a style family or recognizable calligraphic form.
exclusion_rule: Do not infer a style from a logo image without a human note.

definition: Named font family or font asset.
inclusion_rule: The source names a font family or maps it to a GLYPH font_id.
exclusion_rule: Do not guess a font from appearance alone.

definition: The source links the object to premium or elevated value.
inclusion_rule: Explicit wording or an unambiguous equivalent in the source language.
exclusion_rule: A merely positive reaction without the value claim.
notes: Translate into this stable code; retain the original evidence span.

definition: The source links the object to luxury or exclusivity.
exclusion_rule: Generic quality praise without luxury meaning.

definition: The source describes the form or identity as minimal or restrained.
exclusion_rule: Do not equate empty space alone with minimal.

definition: The source describes the object as modern or contemporary.
exclusion_rule: Do not infer from publication date.

definition: The source describes the object as traditional, historical, or heritage-coded.
exclusion_rule: Do not infer from script name alone.

definition: The source links the object to global or international identity.
exclusion_rule: Do not infer from Latin text alone.

definition: The source makes a claim about legibility or ease of reading.
exclusion_rule: Do not substitute the researcher's judgment.

definition: The source describes unfamiliarity, foreignness, or difficulty recognizing the form.
exclusion_rule: Do not code simple non-native status without a claim.

definition: Technology or digital-product context is present.
inclusion_rule: Brand or project belongs to technology/digital products.
exclusion_rule: Generic modernity without a technology context.

definition: Fashion or apparel context is present.
inclusion_rule: Brand or project belongs to fashion/apparel.
exclusion_rule: Aesthetic discussion without a fashion object.

definition: Food, tea, alcohol, or beverage context is present.
inclusion_rule: The source names a food/beverage product or identity.
exclusion_rule: Do not infer from color or shape alone.

definition: Fragrance, cosmetics, or scent context is present.
inclusion_rule: The source names a fragrance/cosmetics product or identity.
